evidence.evidence_text: Clinical trials are vital for evaluation of safety and efficacy of new treatments.

However, clinical trials are resource-intensive, time-consuming and expensive to conduct, where errors in trial design, reduced efficacy, and safety events can result in significant delays, financial losses, and damage to reputation.
Addressing these challenges in trial design can lead to development of more effective study protocols with optimized patient safety and trial efficiency.

Identifying similar historical trials is critical as these trials can provide an important reference for potential pitfalls and challenges including serious adverse events, dosage inaccuracies, recruitment difficulties, patient adherence issues, etc.
